nodes.name: Call Config Gateway
nodes.notes: Bound to WF01_V2_CONFIG_GATEWAY in the current n8n Cloud project.

nodes.name: Call Config Gateway - Command Check
nodes.notes: Reads configured message templates through the current WF01 Config Gateway without invoking a business worker.

nodes.name: Router Decision
nodes.notes: Reads Sheet-driven roles/permissions/topics/commands and writes denied-access events to EVENT_LOG.

nodes.name: Route reservation required?
nodes.notes: Reserve the route idempotency key before acknowledging an accepted command.

parameters.jsCode: const reservation = $json.decision?.reservation; if (!reservation?.row) return []; return [{ json: reservation.row }];

const decision = $('Router Decision').first()?.json?.decision ?? {}; if (decision.kind !== 'ROUTE' || !decision.route?.worker_workflow || !decision.worker_envelope) return []; return [{ json: { envelope: decision.worker_envelope } }];

nodes.name: Prepare Worker Envelope
nodes.notes: Passes only the normalized standard envelope to the worker configured by CONFIG_LENH.

nodes.name: Execute Configured Worker
nodes.notes: worker_workflow in CONFIG_LENH must be the actual n8n workflow ID. The worker receives { envelope }; it must enforce idempotency with operation_id/idempotency_key.

nodes.name: Worker succeeded?
nodes.notes: Only an explicit ok=true result allows the Router success acknowledgement.

parameters.jsCode: const decision = $('Router Decision').first()?.json?.decision ?? {}; const row = decision.reservation?.row; if (!row) return []; return [{ json: { idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key, status: 'COMMITTED', actual_row_count: '1', error_id: '', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];

const decision = $('Router Decision').first()?.json?.decision ?? {}; const row = decision.reservation?.row; if (!row) return []; const errorId = String(decision.worker_failure_error_id ?? '').trim() || `err-${String(row.operation_id ?? 'unknown').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '_')}-worker-failed`; return [{ json: { idempotency_key: row.idempotency_key, status: 'FAILED', error_id: errorId, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
const source = $('Router Decision').first()?.json ?? {}; return [{ json: { reply_target: source.reply_target, text: source.decision?.worker_failure_text ?? '' } }];

nodes.name: Project Worker Failure Reply
nodes.notes: Never sends the accepted text when the worker returned false or threw.

parameters.jsCode: const entry = $json.decision?.write_plan?.[0]; if (!entry) return []; return [{ json: entry.row }];
const reply = $('Router Decision').first()?.json ?? {}; return [{ json: reply }];

nodes.name: Restore Router Reply
nodes.notes: Restores reply_target/text after Google Sheets replaces the item with the appended row.

parameters.jsCode: const source = $json; const chars = Array.from(String(source.text ?? '')); const limit = 4096; if (chars.length === 0) return [{ json: { ...source, text: '' } }]; const chunks = []; for (let index = 0; index < chars.length; index += limit) chunks.push({ json: { ...source, text: chars.slice(index, index + limit).join('') } }); return chunks;

nodes.name: Split Router Reply
nodes.notes: Telegram text limit is technical; preserve every /help line by sending multiple chunks.

nodes.name: Callback query?
nodes.notes: Only callback_query updates need answerQuery; normal messages skip this branch.

nodes.name: Answer Telegram Callback
nodes.notes: Acknowledges the inline-keyboard callback so Telegram clears its loading indicator.
